title: Hate Speech and Offensive Language Detection in Bengali
benchmark_measurement: Hate speech detection against individuals or groups based on their religion.
findings: The paper found that instances of hate speech related to politics or religion can be ambiguous and difficult for models to classify, as the interpretation often depends on the annotator's viewpoint. This ambiguity contributes to model misclassifications in religious contexts.
